# PPR Search Results Guide Available Now

_Category: Uncategorized · Source: BC Registries API community forum_

**Fareen** (4/28/2022):

A new PPR Search Results Guide is available on the BC Registry PPR webpage and can be referred to help understand how to read and interpret a report after completing a search from the PPR application. This guide contains descriptions of all the fields displayed in the report including registration details and historical information on registration amendments.

Link to [PPR Search Results Guide](https://www2.gov.bc.ca/assets/gov/employment-business-and-economic-development/business-management/permits-licences-and-registration/registries-guides/ppr_search_results_guide.pdf)
